messages.content: Hi, my dining table was supposed to arrive today but nobody turned up. Where is it?
Sorry about that. Order OK-48211 was held at our depot after the van ran out of time, and it's now due tomorrow. Can you confirm the postcode is still LS6 2PJ?
yes that's right
Thanks, the address matches. The van is booked for tomorrow and you'll get a text with a 2-hour window by 8am.
I'm at work till 6 tomorrow though, can we make it Saturday morning instead?
I can move it to Saturday between 8am and 12pm. Shall I book that, and is there anything about access, like stairs or parking, the crew should know?
Please book it. It's a ground floor flat and you can park right outside.
Done: Saturday 8am-12pm, ground floor, parking outside noted. You'll get a confirmation email shortly.
and assembly?
Assembly for the table is £45 and the same crew can do it on Saturday. Would you like me to add it?
great, that's everything, thanks

messages.content: Someone broke into my flat yesterday and took my laptop and a camera. How do I claim?
I'm sorry to hear that. I can open the claim now. Have you reported it to the police, and do you have a crime reference number?
Yes, it's CR-55102.
Thank you. I've logged claim LH-7731 for the laptop and camera with crime reference CR-55102. Can you send receipts or photos showing you owned them?
I don't have the receipt for the camera, will that stop the claim going through?
Not necessarily: a bank statement, the original box or old photos of you using the camera can all work as proof of ownership.
They also smashed the back door lock and it won't shut - I can't leave the place like this tonight.
That's an emergency we can help with today. I'm sending a tradesperson to secure the back door this evening; they'll call you within the hour to agree a time.
OK. Going back to the claim, where do I upload the photos of the camera?
You can upload them in your online account under Claims > LH-7731 > Add evidence, or reply to the email we've just sent you.
perfect, thanks for all your help

messages.content: the scooter won't unlock, i've scanned it like 5 times
Sorry about that. Can you read me the 6-digit ID printed under the handlebars so I can unlock it remotely?
Thanks, I've sent an unlock signal to Z48120. You should hear a beep within a few seconds.
It beeped but the light on the handlebar is still red.
A red light means the unlock didn't complete. I've sent it again with a reset; please wait 20 seconds and then squeeze the brake lever once.
Also, should I just try a different scooter if this one still won't go?
Yes, if the light stays red, scan any scooter nearby and I'll mark Z48120 for maintenance.
want my unlock fee back
I've refunded the £1 unlock fee for the failed attempt on Z48120; it will show on your card in 3-5 days.
ok cool thx

messages.content: I parked in the marked bay at the station but still got a £25 penalty for bad parking.
Let me check. The end-of-ride photo shows the scooter partly on the pavement outside the bay. Did you take any other photo?
no, just the one the app asked for
No problem. As the GPS puts you inside the station zone, I'll reduce the penalty to a £5 warning fee this once.
Where exactly are the no-parking zones in the town centre? I don't want this happening again.
In the app, open the map and tap the layers icon; red areas are no-parking zones. The whole High Street pedestrian area is red between 10am and 6pm.
While I've got you, I'd like to switch from pay-as-you-go to the monthly unlimited pass.
The monthly pass is £29.99 for unlimited rides of up to 30 minutes. I can start it today and your card ending 4412 will be charged now and on the same date each month.
Does the pass cover rides longer than 30 minutes?
Rides over 30 minutes are charged at 15p a minute for the extra time; the first 30 minutes stay free.
Back to that penalty - will the warning fee stay on my record?

messages.content: Can I claim the cost of my new laptop as a business expense? I use it for client work.
Yes, equipment used for your business can usually be claimed. If you also use it personally, you claim the business share. Roughly what percentage is for work?
about 80%
Then you'd claim 80% of the cost. Keep the receipt and note the split in your records.
And what about the desk chair I bought for my home office?
Office furniture used for work follows the same rule, so the chair can be claimed as equipment for its business share.
How do I actually mark the laptop like that in the app? There's no equipment option in the category list.
In Transactions, open the laptop payment, tap Category and scroll to 'Capital items'; you can set the business share to 80% there.
book an accountant call
I can book a 30-minute call with one of our accountants. The next slots are Thursday at 10:00 or Friday at 14:30. Which suits you?
friday please

messages.content: We've just hired our first employee and need to set up payroll. Where do I start?
Congratulations! First, add the employee under Payroll > People with their tax code and start date. Do you have their starter form?
Yes, got it here
Great. Enter the details from the starter form, then choose a pay date; the first run will work out their tax automatically.
If I pay her on the 28th, when do I have to send everything to the tax office?
Payroll submissions are due on or before each pay date, so for a 28th pay date Ledgerly will submit on the 28th.
Is adding payroll going to put my monthly Ledgerly price up?
Payroll adds £5 a month per employee, so your next invoice will be £27 instead of £22.
add my bookkeeper as a user
Go to Settings > Team, click Invite and enter your bookkeeper's email. Choose the 'Bookkeeper' role so they can't change billing.
brilliant, thank you

messages.content: My copy of Harbour Lights arrived without the first player token and one of the boards is badly warped.
Sorry about that! I'll send a replacement first player token and a new board. Could you confirm your delivery address?
Same as on the order, 22 Ashby Close.
Thanks, the replacements will be posted to 22 Ashby Close within 5 working days.
While we wait, how does the first player get chosen if we don't have the token?
The rulebook says the player who most recently visited a harbour goes first; the token only marks who that is, so a coin works fine until yours arrives.
And at the end of each round, does first player pass to the left or to whoever has the fewest points?
It passes to the left every round, whatever the scores.
Great. Could you also put a spare box insert in that replacement parcel? Mine has cracked.

messages.content: My watch battery used to last a week, now it's dead after a day and a half.
That's a big drop. Did this start after the latest software update, and do you have the always-on display turned on?
after the update, and yes always-on is on
The update switched always-on display back on for some users. Turning it off should bring you back to 5-7 days.
Turned it off - anything else that eats the battery?
Continuous GPS and overnight blood oxygen tracking use the most power; try setting both to 'during workouts only'.
If that doesn't fix it, it's still under warranty, isn't it? I bought it 8 months ago.
Yes, your watch has a 2-year warranty. If the battery still drains within a week, we can arrange a free repair or replacement.
sleep score looks wrong too
Let's look at that. Is the score much lower than usual, or is it logging times you were awake as sleep?
it says i slept straight through but i was up at 3am

messages.content: I'm on night 40 of the trial and the mattress is too soft for my back. What are my options?
You can exchange it for a firmer model or return it any time before night 100. Would you prefer an exchange or a return?
exchange I think
No problem. I'll set up the exchange, and we'll collect your current mattress when the new one arrives.
Which would suit a side sleeper with lower back pain better, the Firm or the Hybrid?
For side sleepers with lower back pain we usually suggest the Hybrid: it's supportive in the middle but softer at the shoulders than the Firm.
And does the Hybrid come in super king?
Yes, the Hybrid comes in every size from single up to super king.
Great, when's the earliest you could bring the Hybrid round?
The earliest slot is Wednesday 21 October, 7am-1pm, and the driver will take the trial mattress away at the same time.
sounds good, thanks a lot

what would a £500 excess do

ok do that, and switch off auto-renew so I can shop around next year

I've moved your direct debit date to the 15th, starting next month.
need a new schedule copy

messages.content: I sent a bookshelf back last week. Has it reached your warehouse yet?
Yes, return RT-1905 was checked in at our warehouse on Friday and passed inspection.
So when does the £189 come back to me?
The £189 refund was issued yesterday; banks usually take 3-5 working days to show it.
Part of it was paid with a gift card though - does that bit go back onto the card?
Yes, £40 goes back onto the gift card straight away and the remaining £149 to your debit card.
change password?
Go to My Account > Security and choose Change password. If you can't log in, use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page.
One more about the money - could the gift card part go to my bank instead?
Gift card balances can't be paid out to a bank account, but the £40 doesn't expire for 2 years.
fair enough, thank you
